text: 40-year-old female. The patient reports a 5-month history of worsening bladder discomfort, which is relieved by voiding. speaker: Doctor
text:
The lab results show normal renal function and no evidence of infection. Given your chronic pain, frequency, and dyspareunia, I suspect Interstitial Cystitis.

REQUEST TEST: Cystoscopy with Hydrodistension

REQUEST IMAGES: Cystoscopy

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Normal urethra and bladder mucosa

speaker: Doctor
text:
The cystoscopy results showing normal mucosa effectively rule out Hunner's ulcers or other structural abnormalities, which supports a diagnosis of non-ulcer Interstitial Cystitis. Given the classic presentation of chronic pelvic pain, frequency, and dyspareunia with negative infectious and structural workup, I am confident in my assessment.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Interstitial Cystitis
